contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP CONSTANTINVS MAX [AVG] ; R/ [VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP]

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337). Issue of 318-320. Obverse description: Helmeted and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: IMP CONSTANTINVS MAX [AVG]. Reverse description: Two victories holding shield over altar. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 17.56mm, Weight: 2.03gms. Die axis 7
